Manifest.Name: 销赃人 / Fence Expansion
Manifest.Author: Local Mod Development
Manifest.Description: 扩展王尔德的销赃人升级树：15项技能、物资箱扩容与隐匿、钥匙卡品质、黑市访客、大盗与末影人，以及异界消耗品。支持中英文和技能价格配置。Expand Wilde’s network with 15 upgrades, enhanced supply crates and keycards, black-market visitors, the Master Thief, Enderman, and otherworldly consumables. Supports Chinese and English with configurable upgrade costs.
